documents.title: Bulk & Corporate Order Terms
documents.summary: Terms for quantity orders — quotations, advance payment, lead times, tolerances and cancellation.

sections.heading: WHEN THESE TERMS APPLY
body: These terms apply to bulk, wholesale and corporate orders — uniforms, event merchandise, team kit, gifting and reseller runs — alongside our Terms & Conditions. Where the two differ, these terms govern the bulk order.

sections.heading: QUOTATIONS
body: Bulk pricing is quoted per order, not taken from the website, and depends on quantity, garment, print method, number of colours and placements.
A quotation is valid for 15 days unless it says otherwise. Fabric and freight prices move.
The quotation states the unit price, taxes, delivery charge, lead time and payment terms. Anything not in it is not included.
An order is confirmed when you accept the quotation in writing and pay the advance.

sections.heading: PAYMENT
body: Payment terms are: {{payment.terms}}.
We buy fabric and block production capacity on receipt of the advance. Production does not begin before it clears.
The balance is payable before dispatch unless credit terms are agreed in writing.
We issue a GST invoice against {{company.gstin}}. Give us your GSTIN before we invoice — we cannot amend it afterwards for input credit.
Late payment on agreed credit terms may carry interest at the rate stated in the quotation, and may hold up work in progress.

sections.heading: ARTWORK AND APPROVAL
body: Send vector artwork (AI, EPS, SVG or PDF) wherever possible, with fonts outlined and Pantone references for brand colours.
We send a digital mockup for written approval. For large runs we can supply a physical pre-production sample, charged at the rate in the quotation and credited against the order.
Production starts when you approve. The lead time runs from approval, not from the order date.
Changes after approval are a new quotation. Work already done is chargeable.

sections.heading: LEAD TIMES
body: The lead time is stated in the quotation and assumes stock availability and approval on time.
Where a delivery date is critical — an event, a launch — tell us before you order. We will confirm in writing whether we can meet it and what it requires from you.
Bulk orders may be dispatched in batches by agreement.

sections.heading: QUANTITY AND QUALITY TOLERANCES
body: Volume printing is a physical process, and the trade works to tolerances:
Quantity — up to 2% over or under the ordered quantity on runs above 100 pieces. You are billed for what is delivered.
Colour — a commercially acceptable match to the approved reference, not an exact one. Shade varies between fabric lots.
Placement — within about half an inch of the approved position.
Defect rate — up to 2% of a run may carry minor faults. We replace defective pieces above that, or credit them.
Tighter tolerances can be agreed in writing, and are priced accordingly.

sections.heading: INSPECTION AND CLAIMS
body: Inspect a bulk delivery within 7 days of receipt and tell us in writing about shortages or defects, with photographs and the affected quantity. After that the delivery is treated as accepted.
Claims are settled by replacing the affected pieces or crediting them, at our option. Where a fault affects a whole run and we are responsible, we remake the run or refund it.

sections.heading: CANCELLATION
body: Before the advance is paid: cancel freely.
After the advance, before production: we refund the advance less the cost of fabric bought, artwork and set-up already done.
After production starts: the order cannot be cancelled. Custom-printed stock has no other buyer.
If we cannot meet an agreed critical delivery date and you told us it was critical, you may cancel the undelivered part and we refund it in full.

sections.heading: BRANDING, CONFIDENTIALITY AND OWNERSHIP
body: You confirm you may use the brands and logos in your artwork — see the Content & Intellectual Property Policy.
We treat your artwork, quantities and pricing as confidential, and we will not show your work publicly without written permission.
Our print set-ups, separations and working files remain ours.

sections.heading: DELIVERY
body: Bulk orders are delivered by surface freight or courier depending on weight and destination, quoted per order. Delivery is to one address unless the quotation says otherwise; splitting to multiple addresses is chargeable. Someone must be available to receive and sign for the consignment.

sections.heading: CONTACT
body: {{legal.entityName}} · {{company.address}} {{company.email}} · {{company.phone}} · {{legal.supportHours}}

documents.title: Cancellation Policy
documents.summary: You may cancel freely before design work starts. Once you approve a design and production begins, an order cannot be cancelled.

sections.heading: WHEN YOU CAN CANCEL
body: Custom printing is not resellable, so the right to cancel narrows as your order moves through production.
Placed, not yet confirmed — Can you cancel?: Yes — What you get back: Everything you have paid
Confirmed, design not started — Can you cancel?: Yes, within {{order.cancellationWindowHours}} hours — What you get back: Everything you have paid
Design in progress or mockup sent — Can you cancel?: Yes, at our discretion — What you get back: Everything you have paid, less design work already done
Design approved, production started — Can you cancel?: No — What you get back: —
Quality check, packing — Can you cancel?: No — What you get back: —
Dispatched or delivered — Can you cancel?: No — What you get back: —
After dispatch, cancellation is no longer possible. If something is wrong with what arrives, the Return, Replacement & Refund Policy applies instead.

sections.heading: HOW TO CANCEL
body: Write to {{company.email}} or WhatsApp {{company.phone}} with your order number, during {{legal.supportHours}}. Ask us to cancel — do not simply refuse delivery, because a refused parcel takes longer to resolve and costs you the return freight.
We confirm the cancellation in writing and tell you what is being refunded. A cancellation is effective only when we confirm it.

sections.heading: DESIGN WORK ALREADY DONE
body: If our team has already drawn, redrawn or set up your artwork when you cancel, we may keep a reasonable charge for that work, and we will tell you the amount before you decide. If you would rather keep the design, we release the final file to you.

sections.heading: ORDERS WE CANCEL
body: We may cancel an order, and refund you in full, if:
the item is out of stock or the fabric or colour cannot be sourced
the artwork breaks our Content & Intellectual Property Policy
a price or description on the site was clearly wrong
payment fails, is reversed, or an agreed advance is not paid within the time we tell you
the delivery address is outside the areas our couriers serve
we cannot reach you for a design approval after repeated attempts
Where we cancel and you have paid, you get all of it back. We tell you the reason in writing.

sections.heading: UNPAID ORDERS
body: An order that is not paid within the time stated at checkout may be cancelled automatically. We message you before that happens, and you can pay or ask us to hold the order.

sections.heading: REFUNDS AFTER CANCELLATION
body: Refunds go back the way you paid; cash and cash-on-delivery payments are transferred to a bank account you confirm in writing.
We start the refund within 2 working days of confirming the cancellation. Your bank then takes 5–7 working days to show it.
Where design work is charged, we refund the balance and send a statement showing the deduction.
A GST invoice already issued is reversed with a credit note.

sections.heading: CHANGES INSTEAD OF CANCELLATION
body: Before production, tell us what you want changed — size, colour, quantity, artwork, delivery address — and we will amend the order if we can, rather than cancelling it. Once production has begun, changes are no longer possible.

sections.heading: CONTACT
body: {{company.email}} · {{company.phone}} · {{legal.supportHours}}

documents.title: Cookie & Local Storage Policy
documents.summary: We set no cookies and run no analytics. The site keeps a few things in your browser so your basket and wishlist survive a refresh.

sections.heading: WE DO NOT USE COOKIES
body: Our website sets no cookies. There is no analytics, no advertising pixel, no tag manager and no third-party tracking script on any page. Nothing follows you from our site to another one.
That is unusual enough to be worth stating plainly, and it is why you are not asked to dismiss a consent banner when you arrive.

sections.heading: WHAT WE DO STORE ON YOUR DEVICE
body: The site keeps a few items in your browser's local storage so it behaves sensibly between page loads. This data stays on your device. It is not sent to us as a profile, it is not shared, and it is not used to identify you.
Your basket — Why it exists: So items survive a refresh or a closed tab — When it goes: When you clear it, or clear your browser data
Your wishlist — Why it exists: So saved items are still there next visit — When it goes: When you remove them, or clear your browser data
Your sign-in details, where you have an account — Why it exists: So you are not asked for them on every page — When it goes: When you sign out, or clear your browser data
Your last order number — Why it exists: So the tracking page can find your order — When it goes: When you clear your browser data
You can delete all of it at any time from your browser settings, under site data for this site. The site keeps working afterwards — you will simply start with an empty basket.

sections.heading: WHAT THE ADMIN SYSTEM USES
body: Staff who sign in to our internal system receive a session cookie, which keeps them signed in and is required for the system to work at all. It is not set on the public website and is never used for tracking.

sections.heading: PAYMENTS
body: When you pay, our payment partner may set its own cookies on its checkout, to run the payment and prevent fraud. Those are governed by that partner's own policy, not by this one.

sections.heading: IF THIS CHANGES
body: If we ever add analytics or any other non-essential technology, we will:
update this policy before it goes live and change the date at the top
ask for your consent first, with a clear way to say no
keep the site fully usable if you refuse
Essential storage — the basket and sign-in above — has no alternative, and refusing it means the site cannot work.

sections.heading: CONTACT
body: Questions about this policy: {{legal.policyEmail}}

documents.title: Disclaimer
documents.summary: Where printed goods honestly differ from what a screen shows, and what we do and do not promise.

sections.heading: COLOUR
body: The colour you see depends on your screen, its brightness and the light you are sitting in. No two screens agree, and no screen matches dyed fabric or printed ink exactly.

We describe colours as accurately as we can and use the same inks and garments across a run, but a small difference between the image and the item in your hands is normal and is not a defect. If colour is critical — a brand shade, a uniform — ask us for a physical sample before you commit to a run.

sections.heading: PRINT AND FINISH
body: Different print methods give different results. A DTF print feels different from screen print, and embroidery renders fine detail differently again.
Placement is set by hand within a small tolerance. A print may sit a few millimetres from where the mockup showed it.
Mockups are a visualisation, not a photograph of your item. Texture, drape and seams change how a design reads on fabric.
Artwork supplied at low resolution prints softer than artwork supplied at high resolution. We tell you when a file is too small, but the decision to proceed is yours.
Across a large run there is natural variation between garments. We work to a tolerance agreed in the quotation for bulk orders.

sections.heading: SIZES
body: Garment sizes follow the size chart on the product page, measured flat, with a tolerance of about half an inch. Fit varies between styles and between brands, and between how two people like to wear the same shirt. Please measure a garment you already own and compare it with the chart before choosing — a size that fits differently from what you expected is not a defect.

sections.heading: STOCK AND AVAILABILITY
body: Products shown on the site are not a guarantee of availability. Fabrics, colours and sizes go out of stock, and suppliers discontinue lines. If we cannot supply what you ordered, we offer a close alternative or refund you in full.

sections.heading: THE SITE ITSELF
body: We keep the site accurate and available, but we do not promise that it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free of every typographical mistake. Content is provided for general information; we may correct or change it at any time.
Where the site links to another website, that site is not ours, and we are not responsible for its content, products or privacy practices.

sections.heading: GUIDANCE WE GIVE
body: Care instructions, size guidance and design suggestions are offered in good faith to help you get a good result. They are general advice, not a professional or legal opinion, and following them is your decision.

sections.heading: NOT LEGAL OR PROFESSIONAL ADVICE
body: Nothing on this site is legal, tax or professional advice. Our policy pages describe how we run our business; if you need advice about your own position, speak to a professional.

sections.heading: YOUR RIGHTS
body: Nothing in this disclaimer limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, or our responsibility for goods that arrive damaged, defective or different from what you approved. Those are covered by the Return, Replacement & Refund Policy.

sections.heading: CONTACT
body: {{company.email}} · {{company.phone}}

documents.title: Grievance Redressal
documents.summary: How to complain, who handles it, and how long we take to answer.

sections.heading: START WITH OUR SUPPORT TEAM
body: Most problems — a late parcel, a wrong size, a refund that has not landed — are settled fastest by our support team. Write to {{company.email}} or WhatsApp {{company.phone}} during {{legal.supportHours}}, with your order number.
If that does not resolve it, escalate to our Grievance Officer.

sections.heading: GRIEVANCE OFFICER
body: {{legal.grievanceOfficer}}, Grievance Officer {{legal.entityName}} {{legal.grievanceAddress}} {{legal.grievanceEmail}} · {{legal.grievancePhone}}
The officer is appointed under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 and, for data complaints, under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

sections.heading: WHAT TO INCLUDE
body: your order number, and the name and phone number on the order
what went wrong, and when
what you have already been told, and by whom
photographs where the complaint is about the item or the parcel
what you would like us to do

sections.heading: HOW LONG WE TAKE
body: We acknowledge your complaint — Timeline: Within 48 hours
We tell you the outcome — Timeline: Within 30 days of receiving it
Complaints about personal data — Timeline: Within 30 days
Where a claim is accepted, refund started — Timeline: Within 2 working days of the decision
If a complaint needs longer — because a courier or payment partner has to investigate — we tell you why and give you a date.

sections.heading: WHAT WE DO WITH IT
body: Every complaint is logged against your order with a record of who handled it and what was decided, so nothing is lost between shifts and you never have to explain it twice.

sections.heading: IF YOU ARE STILL NOT SATISFIED
body: You may take the matter to:
The National Consumer Helpline — 1915, or consumerhelpline.gov.in
A Consumer Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, including the one where you live
The Data Protection Board of India, for complaints about personal data
Using our process first is not a condition of approaching them.

sections.heading: CONTACT
body: {{legal.grievanceEmail}} · {{legal.grievancePhone}} · {{legal.supportHours}}

documents.title: Content & Intellectual Property Policy
documents.summary: You keep your artwork and give us a licence to print it. You confirm you have the right to use it. Our brand stays ours.

sections.heading: YOUR ARTWORK STAYS YOURS
body: You keep every right you already hold in the artwork, logos, photographs and text you send us. Uploading a file to us does not transfer ownership.

sections.heading: THE LICENCE YOU GIVE US
body: So that we can actually make your order, you give us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use your artwork for these purposes only:
preparing mockups, proofs and print-ready files
printing, embroidering or otherwise applying it to the items you ordered
keeping a copy with your order records, so we can reprint or answer a dispute
showing it to the print, embroidery or packaging partners who work on your order
The licence lasts as long as we hold your order records, and ends when they are deleted.

We do not use your artwork to promote ourselves without asking. If we would like to show your design on our site, social media or a sample, we ask you first and you are free to say no. Bulk and corporate customers may agree otherwise in writing.

sections.heading: WHAT YOU CONFIRM WHEN YOU UPLOAD
body: By sending us a file you confirm that:
you own the artwork, or you have permission from whoever does
printing it does not infringe anyone's copyright, trademark, design right or personality rights
it does not break any law, and it is not defamatory, obscene, hateful or an incitement to violence
if it shows a person, you have their consent; if it shows a child, you have the guardian's consent
If any of that turns out to be untrue, you agree to cover the loss, claim, cost or penalty we face as a result.

sections.heading: WHAT WE WILL NOT PRINT
body: We refuse, and may cancel, any order for:
someone else's trademark, brand name or logo without their authorisation — including sports clubs, brands, universities and institutions
copyrighted characters, artwork, photographs, fonts or music lyrics without a licence
currency, government identity documents, official seals or anything designed to deceive
content that is obscene, sexually explicit involving anyone, or harmful to children
content that incites hatred, violence or discrimination on any ground
content promoting illegal goods or services
the identity of a real person, living or dead, used to impersonate or harass them
If we refuse for these reasons after you have paid, we refund you in full. Where material appears unlawful, we may report it to the authorities and keep a record.
We are not obliged to check every file, and reviewing one does not make us responsible for it. The responsibility for what you ask us to print is yours.

sections.heading: IF YOU THINK YOUR WORK HAS BEEN COPIED
body: If something we have printed or displayed infringes your rights, write to {{legal.grievanceEmail}} with:
what the work is, and proof that you own it
where you saw it — a link, order number, or photograph
your name, address, email and phone number
a statement that you believe in good faith that the use is unauthorised

We acknowledge within 48 hours, take the material down while we look into it, and tell you the outcome within 30 days. If an order is affected, we stop it. Where we take something down, we tell the customer who supplied it, so they can respond.

sections.heading: OUR BRAND AND THIS SITE
body: The Berozgar name, logo, wordmark, site design, photography, product images, illustrations and written copy belong to {{legal.entityName}} or our licensors. You may not copy, reproduce, scrape, sell or adapt them, or use our name or logo to imply a partnership or endorsement, without our written permission.
You may share links to our pages and use our product images to talk about an order you placed with us.

sections.heading: DESIGNS WE CREATE FOR YOU
body: Where our team designs something original for you, and the quotation says so, the finished design is yours once you have paid in full. Until payment, it stays ours. Our working files, templates, colour separations and print set-ups remain ours in every case.

sections.heading: CONTACT
body: {{legal.entityName}} · {{company.address}} {{legal.grievanceEmail}} · {{company.phone}}

documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.summary: What personal data we hold, why we hold it, who we share it with, and the rights you have over it.

sections.heading: WHO WE ARE
body: {{legal.entityName}}, of {{company.address}}, is the data fiduciary for the personal data described here. In plain terms: we decide what is collected and why, and we are answerable for it.

This policy covers {{company.website}}, the order and design approval links we send you, and the messages we send about your order. It is written to meet the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.
Questions about this policy go to {{legal.policyEmail}}.

sections.heading: WHAT WE COLLECT
body: You give us:
name, phone number, WhatsApp number and email address
billing and delivery addresses, including PIN code
what you ordered: product, size, colour, quantity, print type and placement
artwork and design files you upload, and any notes with them
messages you send us, including complaints and support requests
for business customers, a GSTIN and company details for invoicing
We generate as you use the service:
your order history, payment records, invoices and credit notes
design versions, and a record of your approval: who approved, when, the network address it came from, and which version was approved
quality check records and photographs of items made for you
delivery records from our courier partners, including tracking events
a copy of every WhatsApp, SMS and email we send you about your order, including the text of the message and whether it was delivered
if you leave items in a basket, an anonymous session identifier and what was in the basket, so we can offer to help you finish the order
technical records our systems keep for security: the network address a request came from, and what was changed in our admin system and by whom
We do not collect:
full card numbers, CVV or bank credentials. Online payments go directly to our payment partner, who shares only the result and a reference with us.
location tracking, advertising identifiers or profiles bought from third parties.

sections.heading: COOKIES AND WHAT IS STORED ON YOUR DEVICE
body: Today our website sets no cookies and runs no analytics, advertising or tracking scripts. It stores a few things in your browser's local storage so the site works: your basket, your wishlist, your last order number for tracking, and your sign-in details where you have an account. That data stays on your device, is not sent to us as a profile, and you can clear it in your browser at any time.
If we later add analytics or any other non-essential technology, we will update the Cookie & Local Storage Policy, ask for your consent first, and give you a way to refuse.

sections.heading: WHY WE USE IT, AND ON WHAT BASIS
body: Take, make and deliver your order — Why: To perform the contract you asked for — Basis: Your request, and performance of the contract
Send order, design approval and delivery messages — Why: So you know what is happening and can approve designs — Basis: Performance of the contract
Take payment, issue invoices, pay refunds — Why: To complete the sale and meet tax law — Basis: Contract and legal obligation
Keep accounting, GST and audit records — Why: Because the law requires us to — Basis: Legal obligation
Answer questions and handle complaints — Why: To support you — Basis: Contract and legitimate use
Detect fraud, abuse and security incidents — Why: To protect you, us and other customers — Basis: Legitimate use
Follow up an unfinished basket, or send offers — Why: To reach you about something you started or may want — Basis: Your consent, which you may withdraw
We do not sell your personal data. We do not use it to make automated decisions that have a legal effect on you.

sections.heading: WHO WE SHARE IT WITH
body: We share only what each partner needs:
Payment partner (Razorpay) — to take payment and process refunds
Courier partners — your name, delivery address and phone number, to deliver your order
Messaging providers — WhatsApp Business (Meta) and our email provider, to send order messages
File storage — the artwork and mockups for your order, held in our object storage
Professional advisers, auditors and authorities — where the law requires it, or to establish or defend a legal claim

Our partners act on our instructions and may not use your data for their own purposes. Some of them, including messaging and cloud providers, may process data outside India; where that happens we rely on their contractual commitments to protect it.

sections.heading: HOW LONG WE KEEP IT
body: Orders, invoices, payments and tax records — 8 years from the end of the financial year, as accounting and GST law requires.

Artwork, mockups and approvals — while your order is active and for 2 years after delivery, so we can reprint or answer a dispute. Tell us to delete your artwork sooner and we will, unless a dispute is open.
Message logs (the WhatsApp, SMS and email we sent you) — 24 months.
Quality check photographs — 24 months.
Unfinished basket records — 6 months, or until you ask us to delete them.
Security and audit records — 24 months.
After these periods we delete the data or anonymise it so it can no longer identify you.

sections.heading: YOUR RIGHTS
body: You may ask us to:
tell you what personal data we hold about you and who we have shared it with
correct anything inaccurate, incomplete or out of date
delete data we no longer need — though we must keep invoices and tax records for the periods above
stop sending marketing messages, at any time, without giving a reason
withdraw consent you gave us, which stops the use that relied on it
nominate someone to exercise these rights if you die or cannot act for yourself
Write to {{legal.policyEmail}} from the email or phone number on the order. We reply within 30 days. There is no charge. If we cannot act on your request, we will tell you why.

sections.heading: KEEPING IT SAFE
body: We protect your data with encryption in transit, hashed passwords, role-based access so staff see only what their job needs, an audit trail of every change, rate limiting, validated file uploads, verified payment signatures, and regular backups.
No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your personal data, we will notify you and the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires.

sections.heading: CHILDREN
body: Our products and site are meant for adults. We do not knowingly collect data about children under 18 except where a parent or guardian places an order. If you believe we hold a child's data, write to {{legal.policyEmail}} and we will delete it.

sections.heading: GRIEVANCE OFFICER
body: If you are unhappy with how we have handled your data, contact:
{{legal.grievanceOfficer}}, Grievance Officer {{legal.grievanceAddress}} {{legal.grievanceEmail}} · {{legal.grievancePhone}}
We acknowledge within 48 hours and resolve within 30 days. If you remain dissatisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

sections.heading: CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
body: If we change this policy we will publish the new version here with a new date, and tell you if the change is significant. The version in force when you placed an order is recorded against that order.

documents.title: Return, Replacement & Refund Policy
documents.summary: Custom-printed items are replaced or refunded when they arrive damaged, defective or wrong. They cannot be returned for a change of mind.

sections.heading: THE SHORT VERSION
body: Every item we make is printed to your design and your size. Nobody else can wear it or buy it, so we cannot accept it back because you changed your mind.

What we do stand behind: if your order arrives damaged, defective, or different from the design you approved, we replace it or refund you. Tell us within {{order.returnWindowDays}} days of delivery and send a photograph.

sections.heading: WHEN WE REPLACE OR REFUND
body: Raise a claim and we will put it right if:
the item is damaged or stained when it reaches you
the print is defective — cracked, peeling, misaligned, faded or badly cured
the garment is faulty — torn seam, holes, broken stitching
we sent the wrong size, colour, product or quantity against your confirmed order
the print does not match the design you approved, or is a different version of it
the parcel arrived with items missing

sections.heading: WHEN WE CANNOT
body: We cannot replace or refund:
a change of mind, or an item no longer wanted, needed or liked
a size you chose that does not fit. Please use the size chart; measurements are the ones we print to
spelling, artwork, placement or colour choices that were in the mockup you approved. We print what you approve, and we keep a record of that approval
small colour differences between your screen and the printed item, and the natural variation between print runs — see the Disclaimer
artwork supplied at low resolution where we warned you that quality would suffer and you asked us to proceed
damage caused after delivery, including wrong washing or ironing. Wash inside out, cold, and do not iron directly on the print
normal wear after use
items returned without telling us first, or after the claim window has closed

sections.heading: HOW TO RAISE A CLAIM
body: 1. Tell us within {{order.returnWindowDays}} days of delivery. Write to {{company.email}} or WhatsApp {{company.phone}} with your order number. 2. Send photographs. We need a clear photo of the fault, one of the whole item, and one of the shipping label. An unboxing video helps for a damaged parcel but is not required. 3. Keep the item and its packaging until the claim is settled. Do not wash or alter it. 4. We respond within 2 working days. We check your photographs against our quality-check record, the approved design and the packing photographs for your order. 5. If we are at fault, you choose a free replacement or a refund. If a return is needed, we arrange and pay for the pickup. You never pay return shipping for our mistake. 6. If the claim is not covered, we explain why and show you the approval or quality record it turns on. You may escalate to our Grievance Officer.

sections.heading: REPLACEMENTS
body: A replacement is made to the same specification as the original and moves to the front of our production queue. We tell you the new dispatch date when we accept the claim. If we cannot remake the item — the fabric or colour is no longer available — we offer a close alternative or a refund.

sections.heading: REFUNDS
body: Refunds go back the way you paid. Online payments return to the same card, UPI or bank account.
For cash on delivery or cash payments, we transfer to a bank account you confirm in writing.
We start the refund within 2 working days of accepting the claim. Your bank or payment provider then takes 5–7 working days to show it.
We refund the price of the affected item plus the delivery charge you paid for it. Where only part of an order is faulty, we refund that part.
We do not charge a restocking fee.
If your order was cancelled before production, the Cancellation Policy governs what is refunded.
Where an invoice has already been issued, a credit note is raised against it, and both appear on your order page.

sections.heading: ITEMS THAT ARE NOT DELIVERED
body: If tracking shows delivered but you do not have the parcel, tell us within 48 hours. We raise it with the courier, and where the courier confirms loss we replace or refund in full. If delivery fails because the address or phone number was wrong, or nobody accepted the parcel, the Shipping & Delivery Policy applies.

sections.heading: YOUR CONSUMER RIGHTS
body: Nothing here takes away your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 or the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020. If you believe we have got a claim wrong, our Grievance Officer will review it — see the Grievance Redressal Policy.

sections.heading: CONTACT
body: {{company.email}} · {{company.phone}} · {{legal.supportHours}}

documents.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
documents.summary: What delivery costs, how long making and shipping take, and what happens if a parcel goes astray.

sections.heading: WHAT DELIVERY COSTS
body: Orders of {{shipping.freeShippingThreshold}} and above: free standard delivery.
Below that: {{shipping.defaultCharge}} per order.
Express delivery, where available: {{shipping.expressSurcharge}} on top.
The charge for your order is calculated and shown before you pay, and it appears on your invoice. We deliver within India only.

sections.heading: HOW LONG IT TAKES
body: Two periods add up: the time to make your order, and the time to deliver it.
Making — {{legal.dispatchDays}} after you approve the design. Bulk and corporate orders have their own schedule, agreed in the quotation.
Delivery — {{legal.deliveryDays}} after dispatch, depending on the PIN code.

These are working days, and they are our honest estimate rather than a guarantee. Festivals, weather, strikes and courier disruption can add time. If your order is going to be late, we tell you rather than leave you guessing.
Your approval sets the clock. Production starts when you approve the mockup, not when you place the order. A design waiting for approval is not being made.

sections.heading: HOW WE SHIP
body: We dispatch through established courier partners, including Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, XpressBees and Shiprocket, chosen by destination and weight. When your parcel leaves us we send you the courier name and tracking number by WhatsApp or email, and your order page shows every tracking update.

sections.heading: DELIVERY ADDRESSES
body: Give a complete address with a landmark, the correct PIN code, and a phone number the courier can reach.
Tell us before dispatch if the address changes. After dispatch we can only request a redirection, which the courier may refuse.
We deliver to homes and offices. We do not deliver to post-office boxes.
Some PIN codes are not served by any of our couriers, or are served only for prepaid orders. If yours is one of them, we tell you and refund you in full rather than let the order sit.

sections.heading: IF DELIVERY FAILS
body: Couriers normally attempt delivery up to three times, then hold the parcel briefly before returning it to us.
Nobody available, or the phone is unreachable — the courier will try again. Keep the number you gave us switched on.
Wrong or incomplete address given to us — if the parcel comes back, we re-send it once you confirm the correct address and pay the fresh delivery charge.

Parcel refused on arrival — for cash-on-delivery orders, we may ask for prepayment of freight on future orders. Custom-made items that are refused cannot be resold, so the order price remains payable.
Parcel lost by the courier — where the courier confirms loss, we remake or refund in full. You do not pay for their mistake.

sections.heading: WHEN YOUR PARCEL ARRIVES
body: Check the parcel before you accept it. If the packaging is torn, wet or opened, note it with the delivery agent or refuse it, and tell us the same day with photographs.
If tracking says delivered but you do not have it, tell us within 48 hours so we can raise it with the courier while their records are fresh.

sections.heading: SPLIT DELIVERIES
body: Large or mixed orders may be dispatched in more than one parcel, sometimes on different days. You are told each time something ships, and you are never charged more than the delivery charge quoted for the order.

sections.heading: TAXES AND DUTIES
body: Prices and delivery charges include Indian taxes as shown on your invoice. We do not currently ship outside India.

sections.heading: TRACKING YOUR ORDER
body: Every order has a status page. Use the link we sent you, or the order tracking page with your order number and the phone number on the order.

documents.summary: The agreement between you and us when you browse this site or place an order.

sections.heading: ABOUT THESE TERMS
body: These terms govern your use of {{company.website}} and any order you place with {{legal.entityName}} ("we", "us", "our"), a business operating under GSTIN {{company.gstin}} with its place of business at {{company.address}}.

By browsing the site, placing an order or accepting a quotation, you agree to these terms, together with our Privacy Policy, Return, Replacement & Refund Policy, Cancellation Policy, Shipping & Delivery Policy and Content & Intellectual Property Policy. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site or place an order.

We may change these terms. The version that applies to your order is the version you accepted when you placed it; we record that version against your order. Changes are never applied backwards to an order already confirmed.

sections.heading: WHO MAY ORDER
body: You may place an order if you are at least 18 years old and able to enter into a contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. If you are under 18, an order may only be placed for you by a parent or guardian, who accepts these terms on your behalf.
You may order on behalf of a company or organisation only if you are authorised to bind it. For bulk and corporate orders, our Bulk & Corporate Orders terms also apply.

sections.heading: ACCOUNTS AND ORDER LINKS
body: Some parts of the service do not need an account. Where an account exists, you are responsible for the details you give us and for anything done through your account.
We send order status, design approval and tracking links by WhatsApp, SMS or email. These links are the key to your order:
Treat them as private. Anyone with the link can see the order it points to.
Design approval links can be used once and expire after 14 days.
Tell us immediately if you think a link has reached the wrong person, and we will cancel it.

sections.heading: PRODUCTS, CUSTOMISATION AND PRICING
body: Our products are blank garments and other items that we print, embroider or otherwise customise to your instructions.
Prices are in Indian Rupees and include or exclude GST as shown at checkout. The tax rate applied and the HSN code appear on your invoice.
Delivery charges are shown before you pay and are set out in the Shipping & Delivery Policy.
We price every order on our own systems. A price shown to you is calculated by us; a price that reaches us from your device is never trusted.
Colours on your screen are not an exact match for printed or dyed colour. Please read the Disclaimer.

If a price or product description is obviously wrong — a pricing error, a system fault — we may decline or cancel the order and refund you in full rather than supply at that price. We will tell you before doing so.

sections.heading: HOW AN ORDER IS MADE
body: Placing an order is an offer to buy. A contract is formed only when we confirm the order, which we do after checking stock, artwork and payment.
The stages of a custom order are:
New — we have your request and are checking it.
Confirmed — we have accepted it and taken the agreed payment.
Designing — our team prepares a mockup from your artwork or brief.
Awaiting approval — we send you the mockup through an approval link.
Design approved — you have approved it. Production begins.
Production, quality check, packed, shipped, delivered — we make, inspect, pack and dispatch your order.

Your approval matters. When you approve a mockup, we record who approved it, when, from which network address and which version of the design. We print what you approved. Please check spelling, size, placement and colour carefully before approving — once production has begun, changes are not possible and the item cannot be returned for a change of mind.

sections.heading: PAYMENT
body: We accept the methods shown at checkout, which may include Razorpay (cards, net banking, wallets), UPI, bank transfer, cash and cash on delivery. Payment terms for custom work are: {{payment.terms}}.
Part payment is normal for custom orders. Your order page shows what you have paid and the balance due.
Where a balance is due before dispatch, we will not dispatch until it is paid.
Online payments are handled by our payment partner. We never see or store your full card details.
If a payment fails or is reversed after dispatch, you remain liable for the amount due.
We issue a GST invoice for every order. It is available from your order page and is sent to you on delivery.

sections.heading: CANCELLATION, RETURNS AND REFUNDS
body: Because our products are made to your design, they cannot be resold. In short:
You may cancel free of charge before design work begins, and within {{order.cancellationWindowHours}} hours of placing your order.
Once you approve a design and production starts, an order cannot be cancelled and is not returnable for a change of mind.
Items that arrive damaged, defective, or that are not what you approved, are replaced or refunded.
The full rules, timelines and evidence we need are in the Cancellation Policy and the Return, Replacement & Refund Policy, which form part of these terms.

sections.heading: YOUR ARTWORK AND OUR BRAND
body: You keep the rights in the artwork you send us, and you give us a limited licence to print it for your order. You confirm that you have the right to use it, and you agree to cover us if that turns out to be untrue.
The Berozgar name, logo, site design, photography and copy are ours. You may not copy or reuse them without permission.
Both are set out in full in the Content & Intellectual Property Policy.

sections.heading: THINGS YOU MAY NOT DO
body: When using the site or sending us artwork, you may not:
order printing of content that is unlawful, obscene, defamatory, or that incites hatred or violence
use someone else's trademark, logo, photograph or copyrighted work without their permission
impersonate a person, brand or public body
interfere with the site, probe it for weaknesses, scrape it at scale, or try to reach data that is not yours
resell our products as your own manufacture where doing so misleads your own customers
We may refuse or cancel any order that breaks these rules, and we may report unlawful material to the authorities.

sections.heading: IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
body: We take care to describe, make, check and deliver accurately, but we do not promise that the site will always be available or free of error.
To the extent the law allows:
our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for that order
we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, including lost profit, lost business or missed events
nothing in these terms limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that cannot lawfully be limited
Your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 are not affected by anything in these terms.

We are not liable for delays caused by events beyond our reasonable control, including natural events, strikes, civil unrest, epidemics, power or network failure, courier disruption and government action. If such an event prevents us from performing for a long period, either of us may cancel the affected order and we will refund the amount paid for work not yet done.

sections.heading: COMPLAINTS
body: If something is wrong, contact us first — most problems are settled quickly. Write to {{company.email}} or call {{company.phone}} during {{legal.supportHours}}.

If you are not satisfied, our Grievance Officer, {{legal.grievanceOfficer}}, can be reached at {{legal.grievanceEmail}}. The Grievance Redressal Policy sets out acknowledgement and resolution timelines.
